CodeBook — Coursera Getting and Cleaning Data Project

This dataset is derived from the Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones Dataset, The goal of this project is to produce a tidy dataset containing the average of selected measurements for each subject and activity.

Variables in the Final Dataset

The final tidy dataset (tidy_data.txt) contains the following variables:

1. Identifiers
subject
Integer identifier of the participant (range: 1–30)
activity
Descriptive activity label:
WALKING
WALKING_UPSTAIRS
WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS
SITTING
STANDING
LAYING

2. Measurement Variables

All other variables represent the average of original sensor measurements, grouped by subject and activity.

These variables are derived from signals measured from the smartphone sensors and include:

Time-domain signals (prefixed with Time)
Frequency-domain signals (prefixed with Frequency)
Accelerometer signals (Accelerometer)
Gyroscope signals (Gyroscope)
Magnitude signals (Magnitude)

Only variables representing:

mean()
std()

were included in the analysis.

Each variable in the final dataset represents:

The average value of that measurement for a given subject and activity.

Data Transformations

The following steps were performed in run_analysis.R:

1. Merging Data
Training and test datasets were combined into a single dataset.
2. Extracting Relevant Measurements
Only columns containing:
mean()
std()
were selected.
3. Activity Labels
Numeric activity codes were replaced with descriptive names:
WALKING
WALKING_UPSTAIRS
WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS
SITTING
STANDING
LAYING
4. Variable Naming

Original variable names were cleaned and made more descriptive:

t → Time
f → Frequency
Acc → Accelerometer
Gyro → Gyroscope
Mag → Magnitude
Duplicate terms like BodyBody were corrected to Body
5. Creating Tidy Dataset

A second dataset was created where:

Data is grouped by subject and activity
The mean of each variable is calculated for each group
Tidy Data Principles

The final dataset follows tidy data rules:

Each variable forms one column
Each observation forms one row
Each type of observational unit forms one table
Output File
tidy_data.txt
Space-separated text file
Contains averaged measurements for each subject/activity combination
Ready for downstream statistical analysis
Notes
All measurements are normalized sensor signals.
Missing values were not introduced in the final aggregation step.
The dataset is suitable for statistical modeling and machine learning tasks.
